title: Clairambault 1225
contents: Negotiations to sell the island of Tabarka, secret intelligence and a disputed Genoese inheritance; the princess of Parma’s marriage to the king of Spain and the Farnese succession.
fields: 113 codes, 20 letter codes, 89 in nomenclature, 4 unidentified
Interlinear plaintext on ff53r–54r, f57v and ff58r–59r.

excerpt: **qualitez qu’on** peut desirer. **Elle achevera sa** 22e **année le** 25 **Octobre prochain**, estant **née le mesme mois en mil** 692. **Elle est bien faite, blonde, le visage rond, les traits fins et** assez reguliers, **et la taille belle**, quoy que **moyenne, beaucoup d’esprit et un air** fort **modeste**.
translation: Qualities one could wish for. She will complete her twenty-second year on 25 October next, having been born in the same month in 1692. She is well formed and blonde, with a round face, fine and fairly regular features, and a fine figure, though of medium size; much intelligence and a very modest manner.
